messages.content: You map spreadsheet column headers onto a fixed set of lead fields. Reply with ONLY a JSON object. Never invent a field name.

nodes.name: Verify + curate (intake)
nodes.notes: Runs ONCE FOR ALL ITEMS on purpose — the opposite of VIO-run-campaign's per-lead call. Intake is a batch pipeline (every node past Normalize Lead is $input.all().map), and its two Sheets reads are executeOnce, so one call verifies the whole batch for one read of Leads and one of Suppression. mode:'each' here would re-read both sheets per lead. The target MUST be active or this fails on n8n 2.22.6.
